name: Preserve Numbers and Dates
text: In 2024, our team processed over 1,450,000 transactions with a 99.98% success rate, saving $450,000 in operational costs.
criteria: Preserve all numerical figures, statistics, and currency values exactly.

name: Preserve URLs and Emails
text: For further inquiries, visit https://cutm.ac.in or contact the admissions department directly at support@cutm.ac.in before Friday.
criteria: Preserve URLs and email addresses without corruption.

name: Preserve Academic Citations
text: Recent longitudinal studies (Smith et al., 2021) and follow-up meta-analyses [12] demonstrate significant cognitive resilience in bilingual subjects.
criteria: Retain parenthetical and bracketed citation styles.

name: Preserve Code Blocks
text: You can easily check the array length using `array.length` or run `npm install --save-dev @types/node` in your terminal.
criteria: Retain inline code backticks and commands.

name: Eliminate Robotic Transitions
text: In conclusion, it is important to remember that furthermore, artificial intelligence delves into a tapestry of modern human capabilities.
criteria: Strip out formulaic AI clichés like 'delves into', 'a tapestry of', and 'in conclusion'.

name: Academic Tone Transformation
text: We did a bunch of tests and found out that the new formula really works great and fixes the big problems.
criteria: Transform casual slang into scholarly, objective academic vocabulary.

name: Conversational Warmth
text: Individuals possessing authorization must forthwith execute credentials authentication to facilitate database access.
criteria: Transform stiff bureaucratic jargon into warm, accessible human English.

name: Condense Wordy Passage
text: Due to the fact that we are currently operating in an environment of rapid change, it is absolutely essential and of paramount importance that we take immediate action in order to make improvements.
criteria: Condense wordy filler into a concise, punchy sentence.
